value.title: The US government is shut down on December 12, 2026
value.text: The federal government is at least partially shut down for lack of appropriations at 10:00 AM ET on December 12, 2026, the morning after the continuing resolution expires. It would be the third shutdown of 2026. Some Senate Democrats say they will not vote for a stopgap that leaves the Iran war unrestricted.
value.resolution_source: Office of Management and Budget; Office of Personnel Management
